title: Palm Sugar Empanadas
description: A sweet and crispy empanada dessert filled with palm sugar and exotic flavors, inspired by Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a small spoonful of palm sugar in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few drops of exotic fruit jam and a pinch of Venezuelan vanilla extract.
Fold the dough in half to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with Venezuelan shortening and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: dust with powdered sugar before serving.
